suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as pulmonary disease complication. Require documented bronchiectasis and separately documented pulmonary hypertension using appropriate hemodynamic/clinical evidence. Do not infer pulmonary hypertension from bronchiectasis severity alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Bronchiectasis and Pulmonary Hypertension
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented bronchiectasis and separately documented pulmonary hypertension using appropriate hemodynamic/clinical evidence. Do not infer pulmonary hypertension from bronchiectasis severity alone.
